quantum_hypothesis_test.question: does the 2700 s work-quantum figure explain the death of run 39043684319's producer step?
why: the producer step of 39043684319 ended at 2704 s of wall clock, i.e. 4 s past the 2700 s figure that factory-direction requirement 10 records, and the SAME 2704 s figure is independently reproduced on a DIFFERENT job's DIFFERENT step (39027041693 'Independent audit'). Two independent reproductions of the same number on two different jobs is not noise.

it is equally NOT a step-level ceiling: the IDENTICAL step 'Run lane cycle' SUCCEEDED at 3484 s (39027041693) and 3109 s (39033797087). A ceiling that admits a 3484 s step cannot terminate a 2704 s step, so the quantum cannot be a wall-clock limit on the step.

the only reading consistent with all five measurements is a budget applied INSIDE the agent invocation (per attempt / work-quantum) whose wall-clock footprint is not a strict function of the quantum: an invocation that runs long can still be admitted, while one that keeps asking for more work is cut at the budget.

and the mechanism is still absent from the control plane readable in this checkout (0 hits for the quantum token; no wall-clock ceiling and no rc 78 in run-ox-with-retry.sh; job timeouts are 360/300 minutes), so it lives outside the tree read here or was removed from it.
quantum_hypothesis_test.what_remains_true: cycle 39043684319's recorded verdict FALSIFIED_AS_THE_EXPLANATION_FOR_39040205229 is NOT reopened and NOT contradicted: run 39040205229's producer step ran 2868 s, 168 s PAST the boundary, and its own recorded reason (retry exhaustion / propagated provider failure) stands as an INFERENCE. The falsification was correctly scoped to that run in the artifact and in reports/evaluation/CYCLE_39043684319.md.
quantum_hypothesis_test.what_this_cycle_adds: the falsification is a fact about 39040205229 only. Run 39043684319 is a SECOND, different failure class: it lands ON the boundary, twice reproduced across two jobs. Generalizing 'the quantum is falsified' to every producer death would discard accepted evidence; the correct standing rule is to classify each producer death against the five measured durations before attributing it.

root_causes_of_the_validation_defect.what: check 5 (state_evidence_refs_resolve) ran BEFORE the readiness record was written, so when state/evaluation.json cited the readiness record of the CURRENT run - which it must, the record is the audit input - the ref could not exist yet. The check's verdict therefore depended on whether the verifier had been run before, i.e. it was structurally unpassable on first execution.
root_causes_of_the_validation_defect.repair: the record's own path is classified as a self-reference and excluded from the unresolved set; it is then VERIFIED AFTER the write by reading the record back and matching its schema and run_id, and the outcome is published in record.post_write_self_reference. A failed verification downgrades the verdict and the exit code. With record_path=None the pre-repair behaviour is unchanged.
